p.strong: Autonomous Greenfield & Brownfield Flake Synthesis Pipeline

g.title: User requests a new dev environment or nixifying an existing project
Main reasoning loop synthesizing Nix requirements and orchestrating tools
Composes flake inputs, forAllSystems, devShells, and packages
Triggered via agent skill mechanism (e.g. /d2, nix-flake-expert)

ul.li: Hooks: shellHook env vars & setup scripts

g.title: Model Context Protocol client connection
Fast index and query engine over Nixpkgs and NixOS options
Validates flake syntax, purity, and input locks
Spawns hermetic dev environment to test toolchains
Checks return code and build log
Complete, reproducible Nix flake configuration
Locked cryptographic hashes of inputs
Isolated development environment ready for developer use
Desired languages, frameworks, services (e.g. Rust, Go, Postgres)
Choose templates: devShell, fenix, crane, devenv, dream2nix
Inspect existing code files, ASTs, and directory layout
Detect package.json, Cargo.toml, pyproject.toml, Dockerfile, Makefile
Extract system libraries (libssl, pkg-config, cmake, glibc headers)
Finds canonical attribute names (e.g. pkgs.openssl, pkgs.rustPlatform)
Queries available module options & devenv parameters
Pre-evaluates syntax & attribute validity
